def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    mark=next((x for row in grid for x in row if x!=bg),None)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    if mark is None: return out
    for r in range(h):
        positions=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v==mark]
        for a,b in zip(positions,positions[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    for c in range(w):
        positions=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==mark]
        for a,b in zip(positions,positions[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    return out
